# Hugo Ferrer - UX/UI Designer Portfolio

## About

Hugo Ferrer is a Lead UX/UI Designer based in Paris, France.
Specializes in: Government digital services, SaaS B2B platforms, 
e-learning, accessibility (RGAA/WCAG), Design Systems (DSFR).

## Key Projects

- Gouvernement.fr: UX/UI work at the Government Information Service (SIG) on info.gouv.fr: DSFR and RGAA audit, redesigned priority policy journeys, mockups and design system contributions. Live site: https://www.info.gouv.fr/

- AgoraSquare: B2B platform redesign for Rungis market wholesalers. Digital transformation combining order management, solvency checks, electronic invoicing, and accounting.

- Data Collection (B2B SaaS, client name withheld): discovery and design of document collection for an HR and finance consulting firm: eight user interviews, then four user journeys (sales, client, manager, consultant) to request, upload, check and follow up on payroll and HR documents.

## Expertise

- UX Research & Strategy
- UI Design & Prototyping
- Design Systems (especially DSFR for French government)
- Accessibility compliance (RGAA/WCAG standards)
- Figma, Design Tokens, Component Libraries
- Front-end Development (HTML/CSS/JavaScript/React)
- Video Production (Premiere Pro, After Effects)
